units.source_text: 我的脚没有停下来的意思。

en.t: My feet showed no sign of stopping.

units.source_text: 不管走向哪儿或走到哪儿，我都要达到目的。

en.t: No matter where I headed or where I arrived, I was determined to reach my destination.

units.source_text: 我要去的地方的名字，也没有任何的意义。

en.t: Even the name of the place I was going had no meaning at all.

units.source_text: 不管是什么，我心中都产生一股直面达到的目的的勇气、

en.t: Whatever it was, there arose in my heart a courage to face my goal directly and reach it,
a courage that was almost immoral.
